sample_unit: ADNI-3 subjects (plus 207 OASIS-3 subjects for external replication)

links.outcome: Fidelity of explainability attribution maps to AD biomarker regions across methods and architectures
links.effect: Integrated Gradients had highest Biomarker Fidelity Score across all three architectures; GradCAM++ consistently lowest (all p<0.001). Rankings replicated on OASIS-3 (Spearman 0.964, max absolute difference 0.0005).
links.quote: Integrated Gradients achieved the highest BFS across all three architectures while GradCAM++ consistently showed the lowest biomarker alignment (all p<0.001, Friedman test).

unlisted_practices: Individual-level quantitative validation of explainability methods against atlas-defined biomarker regions (Biomarker Fidelity Score)

screen.reason: Evaluates and benchmarks a quantitative validation framework (Biomarker Fidelity Score) across multiple explainability methods on multi-cohort 3D MRI data to guide trustworthy AI deployment.
